column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Lebo Hamath” is rendered “the entrance of Hamath,” and “they will belong to him, the east side [to] the sea” “from its east to its west side.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the contribution” is rendered “the district.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a contribution from the contribution of the land” is rendered “this district of land that is set apart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “make pass over” is rendered “alienate.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a profane area” is rendered “for general use,” and “open land” “common-land.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will serve it” is rendered “shall cultivate it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “fourth” is rendered “foursquare,” and “to the possession of the city” “with the property of the city.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the wadi” is rendered “the brook.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV runs this verse into verse 31, placing the note on the gates’ names in parentheses.
